core_contract.objective: L(theta,alpha)=sum_received(0.5*((mu_k(theta,alpha)-V_k)/sigma)^2); prior separate once. Preserve centered likelihood contrasts and the gradients driving updates.
core_contract.physical_state: Every retained representation must preserve the parameter-dependent boundary/state map and actual input intervals/order, not only voltage residual rows.
core_contract.unknowns: Keep unexcited/provisional estimates and alternate supported modes; never tighten uncertainty because history was discarded.
core_contract.error: Keep0.1NLL finite-point gate; expand predeclared nodes to desktop checkpoints and motion corridors. A pass is finite-node evidence, not all-domain coverage.
core_contract.budget: All live factors,boundary states,raw ring,workspace,ingress,configuration,stack,IRQ and saturation behavior count.

options.name: Fixed nonlinear response basis with square-root evidence
options.mechanism: Choose response nodes/basis over declared public nonlinear support; propagate RC/hysteresis states at fixed nodes with every actual sample; construct a structured residual basis and accumulate one QR likelihood factor. Keep original amplitudes exact. No shift of historical Taylor origin.
options.benefit: Directly targets lost parameter dependence and approximate boundary transport under moving estimates.
options.risk: Interpolation/OCV approximation, dense cross-products, wide seven-dimensional nonlinear support, accumulated contrast error. Growing basis after observations are discarded cannot recover missing old statistics.
options.deployment_fit: Unknown; same37feature factor5624B is plausible only if its fixed basis meets accuracy. Degree3 analogue55features factor12320B already exceeds10KiB before other memory.
options.first_test: Desktop basis/order/error decomposition over public support and observed motion, fixed before reference results; separate RC,hysteresis,OCV and boundary errors; no refitting to truth.

options.name: Several local square-root summaries with validity regions
options.mechanism: Keep disjoint time-block factors or explicitly alternative full-history charts; retain origin/domain/error metadata; merge only with demonstrated validity. Recent raw window supports local relinearization.
options.benefit: Avoids forcing every observation into one changing chart; local amplitude/parameter dependence can be economical.
options.risk: Disjoint-time factors still must evaluate at current parameters. Old approximate rows cannot be repaired by re-centering. Alternative charts describing the same observations must never be added. Memory saturation and out-of-domain behavior are required.
options.deployment_fit: 17-feature affine residual factor1224B; four factors4896B before anchors/boundaries/metadata/workspace. First-order approximation may need domains too small for early motion.
options.first_test: Fixed two/four-summary budgets at desktop checkpoints and movement corridor; declare merge/refusal policy and account all boundary-state storage.

options.name: Bank of fixed nonlinear hypotheses with exact conditional amplitude evidence
options.mechanism: At fixed seven nonlinear coordinates, residual is affine in nine amplitude quantities including H*h0. Ten-feature augmented factor has55entries/440B. Maintain separate likelihood alternatives, not additional data.
options.benefit: Much smaller conditional evidence factors; accurately preserves amplitude coupling at maintained nonlinear hypotheses.
options.risk: Few hypotheses may miss supported nonlinear modes. New hypotheses cannot inherit exact old evidence without old history. Prior in original H,h0 coordinates is not Gaussian in H,H*h0; retain its exact density/support and H=0 semantics.
options.deployment_fit: Eight factors3520B, plus per-hypothesis dynamic state, coordinate locations, original prior, workspace and scheduling. Sparse seven-dimensional coverage unproven.
options.first_test: Use as an interpretable benchmark for how many distinct rate/capacity alternatives must survive, not as evidence that8points cover the model.

options.name: Representative chronological segments with weights and boundary models
options.mechanism: Select informative segments preserving weighted residual behavior, current/time chronology and parameter-dependent entering states; keep acquisition inputs needed to reconstruct state between selected voltage observations.
options.benefit: Retains some nonlinear evaluability for less storage than full history.
options.risk: An isolated voltage/current row is not a self-contained datum: state depends on preceding current. Exact entering state depends on queried parameters. Standard linear-regression coreset guarantees do not transfer automatically. Percentage total-cost error is not the required centered0.1NLL contrast guarantee.
options.deployment_fit: Segment payload, weights and boundary maps can dominate. No exact bytes claim before choosing schema.
options.first_test: Compare retained bytes including forcing/boundary information; reject any apparent compression that omits prerequisite history.

options.name: Short raw window plus marginalized older evidence
options.mechanism: Retain raw recent records and one/more older likelihood summaries; keep original public prior separate.
options.benefit: Practical component for recent transients and near-term relinearization.
options.risk: Does not repair old evidence compressed during large parameter movement; fixed-lag marginalization freezes nonlinear approximations.
options.deployment_fit: With current4592B nonfactor plan and one1224B affine factor, only4424B remain:276current16Brecords, about7.89seconds before new metadata.
options.first_test: Use within a broader compressor, not as the primary answer to2–31minute historical error.

options.name: Mixed precision, scaling and selective low-rank storage
options.mechanism: Reduce representation bytes after selecting a faithful family; keep square-root form and measured error accounting.
options.benefit: 37featurefactor2812B in binary32 instead of5624B, potentially freeing2812B.
options.risk: Does not cure structural truncation. Final public-SD scaled GN condition ratio1.11e8; discarded weak directions may matter after new excitation. GN is not a coverage certificate.
options.deployment_fit: Potential supporting optimization, no all-float32 approval; target software arithmetic/latency must be measured.
options.first_test: Re-encode saved factors and bound computed-cost/gradient differences, then test long accumulation and weak directions; no simultaneous semantic change.
